pages.content:
On every SEED-IT user's profile page, the list of problems that they have set, tested, and written editorials for, is listed at the bottom. 

Given the number of problems in each of these $3$ categories as $X, Y,$ and $Z$ respectively (where all three integers are **distinct**), find if the user has been most active as a `Setter`, `Tester`, or `Editorialist`.

pages.title: Review problem - 2
pages.content:
Chef is shopping for masks. In the shop, he encounters $2$ types of masks: 
- Disposable Masks — cost $X$ but last only $1$ day.
- Cloth Masks — cost $Y$ but last $10$ days. ($X \lt Y$)

Chef wants to buy masks to last him $100$ days. Which type of mask will Chef choose?
- He will buy the masks which cost him the least.
- In case there is a tie in terms of cost, Chef will be eco-friendly and choose the cloth masks.
